why_frozen_now: the bar is registered before any differential-O-typing code exists, so it cannot be tuned to the result. A prior version guarded H axes 'where both resolve', a denominator that SHRINKS if the fix adds abstentions -- a fix converting wrong calls into no-calls could have passed.
accuracy_denominator: ALL 200 cohort isolates, and accuracy means WET-LAB-LABEL accuracy, never agreement with SeqSero2. A SeqSero2-agreement bar would be circular once we port its logic.
adopt_if_ALL_hold: O-axis agreement with SeqSero2 rises by >= +15 isolates over the baseline 159, on the fixed 200-isolate denominator (not on rows where both resolve)
H1 agreement does not fall below baseline AND H1 ours_unresolved does not rise above baseline
H2 agreement does not fall below baseline AND H2 ours_unresolved does not rise above baseline
overall wet-lab accuracy does not fall below the baseline 0.7050
overall no_call does not rise above the baseline 20
explicitly_not_a_success_signal: a rise in O agreement achieved by converting wrong calls into abstentions
any improvement measured on a denominator restricted to post-change resolved rows
agreement with SeqSero2 used as the accuracy metric
